name: feature.webinars.nodes
description: Webinar connector node pack (ADR 0404) — `register` (push a registrant to the provider via the Connections broker + record the CRM registration) and `sync` (backfill-reconcile an event's attendance + no-shows). Over ctx.features.webinars; adapterOnly consumer of the zoom-webinar provider (the governed registrant write can never ride ctx.http.fetch).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Webinar: Register Attendee
nodes.description: Pushes a registrant to the webinar provider through the acting user's Connection (adapterOnly zoom-webinar) and records the CRM `registered` activity. Inputs: { orgId, webinarId, email, name? }. Output: { success, registrantId?, joinUrl?, error? }.

nodes.label: Webinar: Sync Attendance
nodes.description: Backfill-reconciles a webinar event's attendance + no-shows over ctx.features.webinars.syncEvent (15-min cooldown; best-effort; idempotent deterministic-id activities). Inputs: { orgId, eventId }. Output: { success, outcome: 'synced'|'cooldown'|'error', attendees?, noShows?, retryAtIso?, reason? }.
